title: The Nelson Riddle band's trombones and length of work
summary: Tommy Peterson played first trombone, Tizol third, with a bass trombonist whose name he forgets; they did a year of the show, plus one-nighters and recordings.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: Who else was in that band? Was it all studio musicians or was there anybody else who had a name?

Well, I don't know. What's the name? Nelson Riddle would pick his band and keep them there all the time, like Tommy, the trombone player -- he was first trombone when I was there met-him; I was playing the third trombone.
And the bass trombone, oh, what's his name -- he does all this work over here in California; terrific bass trombone, but I forgot what his name is.
Ruscher or something like that, isn't it?
No, no. I forgot his name, but he was wonderful, and he was a nice fellow, too.
So how long all together did you work with Nelson Riddle?
Oh, with Nelson Riddle, well, we did the show for one year, and then he did some one nighters, and I played ...
